acceptance_criteria.description: Migration validation, scope and whitespace checks pass with code/defaults unchanged.

evidence.command: Self-review under user-requested process update and existing explicit self-review delegation: root/task/plan/guardrail/template consistent; existing substantive compatibility/security/oracle/default requirements preserved
